semantic.justification: Native export-side FastAttributeList contiguous58byte initial chunk, original doubling/exact growth, NUL termination, offset count including initial zero, first-match lookup, duplicate tokens and independent copy/clone. UTF16 strings use existing UTF8 binding. Parser token conversion, unknown attributes, UNO and allocator ABI remain unported; only the null-handler export construction is admitted. J0Z0KF ports original AttributeConversion::decodeXString, its literal/hex pointer scan and comphelper::string::sanitizeStringSurrogates, plus actual FastAttributeList counted UTF8 Unicode values and optional/defaulted AttributeList string/XString queries. RichStringPortion owns decoded actual SAL Unicode text; RichString preserves ordered text/run portions, attributes and concatenation. Native lowercase-x and four-hex-unit recognition, one-pass underscore escaping, no-marker COW fast paths, marker-triggered first-invalid-surrogate truncation, first-duplicate attributes, missing versus empty and undecoded fallback defaults are retained. Private preserve-space state uses a monotone boolean assignment equivalent to setting true; its unused downstream native role is not repaired with whitespace trimming or a new public getter. Font/phonetic/binary/UNO/edit-engine conversion and finalization, RichStringContext/SharedStringsBuffer, workbook helpers/filter and shell/UI acceptance remain unported. Local direct model-write tests do not claim XLSX parse/import, shared-string lookup, rich formatting, XML context orchestration or independent native compilation. J0Z0KF connects original FastTokenHandlerBase direct lookup, borrowed handler/copy/clone propagation and actual FastTokenHandler to native FastAttributeList token/value/numeric/view queries. Optional/defaulted AttributeList token, integer/double/unsigned/hyper/hex/bool results delegate to these owners and existing real SAL/o3tl parsers. Original byte-view toDouble is added beside UTF16 without host parseFloat/Number replacement. Native missing output zeroing, untouched missing view, first duplicates, present unknown token retaining invalid despite default, present invalid/empty signed numeric zero, unsigned/hyper/hex empty absence, signed64-then-unsigned saturation, unsigned-hex signed cast and boolean exact/token/numeric fallbacks are retained. No fake token handler, injected result map, temporary parser facade, null-handler token-call witness or native null-pointer/ABI claim is introduced. Original FastTokenHandlerBase WeakImplHelper/XFastTokenHandler service registration, complete SAX/attribute APIs, independently compiled original numeric/attribute differential and complete workbook/filter/model/UI acceptance remain unported or unverified. Continuation: FastTokenHandlerBase now derives actual WeakImplHelper<XFastTokenHandler>, with abstract native const Sequence input and owned Sequence result plus original direct lookup. FastAttributeList itself still has only the previously consumed chunk/numeric/view/copy operations; its complete UNO facets, unknown attributes and iterator interfaces remain unported. No fake parser/provider or inferred physical allocation claim is introduced. Continuation supersedes the earlier partial FastAttributeList UNO/unknown-attribute statement: actual WeakImplHelper<XFastAttributeList,XCloneable>, native Reference clone/copy/cast, required SAXException values, optional strings, real UnknownAttribute OUString/OString ownership and initialized native Attribute24/FastAttribute16 result sequences are implemented. All source sax/qa/cppunit/attributes.cxx assertions are ported, with additional real service-handler lookup, facet identity, duplicate/order/Unicode/embedded-NUL/snapshot lifetime, append/copy/clone and every iterator operation. Byte/Unicode add overloads use actual native OString conversion rather than host TextEncoder; declared typed-array element widths bind compile-time view overloads across realms. Source pointer/chunk behavior is retained logically, while physical malloc/free/realloc, primitive std::vector reserve capacity and pointer invalidation remain unqualified. No fake provider/private-field/native-thread certificate is introduced. Existing FastParser, native Parser/context and complete document filter/model/UI acceptance remain unfinished.
